verdict.rationale: Embeddings and reranking are a fair question for an LLM inference API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an embeddings or rerank endpoint or model. The documented surface covers chat completions, streaming, structured outputs, tool calling, batch, image inputs and caching, and OpenAI compatibility alone does not show an embeddings endpoint exists.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor
